title: Oura Ring media slot
description: A media slot that fills its box: a real image or video (cover-fitted) when given, otherwise a plain placeholder surface, warm sand for light pictures or warm ink for dark ones.
notes: the deep tone scopes itself dark (class dark), so it stays a dark panel under any theme and mode
size, corners and position come from the className the block passes
name: ouraring-media

props.name: media
props.description: an or

props.name: tone

props.name: fit
props.description: fit for a given image or video
